info.title: ACS Billing Integration API
info.description: External systems use opaque Bearer tokens generated for a user in Users and Roles. The API resolves the user's current permissions on every call. Only /v1 routes accept API tokens; browser session cookies do not authenticate /v1. Use HTTPS through the configured reverse proxy (normally /api/v1), never expose the backend port. ADMIN_WEB_ALLOWED_CIDRS applies to integration clients too. Cached reads return stored values; fresh reads and writes are asynchronous CWMP tasks. Tokens expire after 1–365 days (default 90), can be revoked, and become unusable when the owner is deleted. Keep tokens outside URLs, browser storage and logs. Limits apply per API process. JSON requests are limited to 2 MiB. See docs/integration-api.md for complete deployment, rotation, pagination and retry guidance.

post.summary: Request fresh values from the CPE
post.description: Requires devices.write (also devices.read to poll the result). Queues GetParameterValues. Object paths ending in a dot can retrieve a subtree. Execution waits for a CWMP session; this call does not send a connection request. Offline devices can remain pending. Poll task detail until completed, failed or deleted; then inspect result/error_message. Keep the same idempotency key when retrying a timeout.

200.description: Existing task returned for an identical idempotent retry.

Location.description: Relative task URI (tasks/{id}); resolve against the POST request URL to preserve any reverse-proxy /api prefix.

202.description: CWMP task queued; not proof of device completion.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Recommended unique key per logical request. Scoped to the token across read/write and all devices. Identical retries return the same task with 200; different payload/device/operation returns 409. Guarantee lasts only while the task is retained. Without a key every POST creates a new task.

get.summary: List token metadata for a user
get.description: Console session only. Requires full access AND users.read. Secret/digest never returned. Includes revoked and expired tokens. Use Users and Roles in the console.

403.description: Full-access administrator and users permission required; mutations also require matching CSRF cookie/header and allowed Origin.

post.summary: Generate a token for an external system
post.description: Console session only. Requires full access AND users.write, plus matching acs_csrf cookie and X-CSRF-Token header. Maximum 100 active tokens per user. Secret returned exactly once. Token inherits owner's current permissions; no independent grants. Password changes/2FA resets do not revoke service tokens; revoke them explicitly. 2FA remains enforced on console login.

201.description: Token generated. Copy token to a secret manager now.

403.description: Full-access administrator and users permission required; mutations also require matching CSRF cookie/header and allowed Origin.

409.description: 100 active tokens already exist for this user.

delete.description: Console session only. Requires full access AND users.write, with CSRF protection. Repeated revocation is safe. Blocks subsequent authentication; already queued/in-flight CWMP work is not cancelled.

get.description: Requires a console session. The same JSON is shipped in the repository for offline Swagger/Postman/client generation. Covers the integration API and its token management endpoints; internal console APIs are outside this contract.

bearerAuth.description: acs_… secret generated in Users and Roles. Not a web JWT.

sessionCookie.name: acs_session
sessionCookie.description: Console session established through normal sign-in including required 2FA; API tokens cannot administer tokens.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Must equal the acs_csrf browser cookie for console mutations.

error.description: Human-readable error. Do not parse this text as a stable error code.

value.description: Stored value; sensitive values are [REDACTED] unless the owning user has full access.

writable.description: Absent when the device has not reported writability.

updated_at.description: Time the ACS last stored this value; not proof that the device is currently reachable.

payload.description: Null in creation acknowledgements and lists. In detail: read paths as an array or write values as an object. Sensitive values are redacted for every role.

result.description: Null until available and in lists. GetParameterValues: path/value object. SetParameterValues: {status:0} (applied) or {status:1} (accepted, may require reboot). Other console-created task types have type-specific results.

permissions.description: Current user permissions, resolved on each request. Only the documented /v1 surface is available to tokens.

prefix.description: Non-secret prefix for identification; not usable for authentication.

token.description: Secret returned once. Store in a secret manager; never put it in a URL or logs.

name.description: Required external system name; trimmed, max 128 UTF-8 bytes.

items.description: Exact path or object prefix ending with a dot. Wildcards and surrounding whitespace are not supported.

parameters.description: Map of exact leaf paths to string values (including numbers/booleans). Path limit 512 bytes; value limit 4096 bytes. Known read-only paths, wildcards, object paths and surrounding whitespace are rejected.

next_cursor.description: Empty string means the last page. Otherwise pass unchanged as cursor, retaining the same filters. This is a live listing, not a snapshot.
